rules.visual: Use photoreal scanned plants/stumps as hero. Animals are original PBR authored figures, not certified photoreal; review visually.
rules.animation: A static walking cat is a pose only. Rig-only base humanoid has zero animations. Do not claim ghost or monster rig.
rules.safety: No game modification. Read local availability from public/viralio-3d/index.json and materials/index.json.
rules.perf: Hero plants may include high mesh counts and alpha textures; test WebGL mobile with 1K textures before any deployment.
